ns2:section.sectionText: Be sure to enroll in the desired credit amount (2 or 4 hours) for this variable credit course. Meets the last two weeks of SS1: Tuesday-Friday, June 2-June 5, and Monday-Friday, June 8-June 12. Required overnight field trip Wednesday & Thursday, June 10 & 11. A $55 non-waived course fee will be assessed to the student's tuition/fees bill for the field trip. In addition, the student will be responsible for meals and one night's lodging expenses while on the field trip. Contact the instructor (fschlipf@illinois.edu) with questions or for further details about the course.
